tools.name: search_records
tools.description: Search the full public MCP Index. The tools on this connection are only the Index, not the catalog. Pass the job as query. Optional host is cursor, copilot, or vscode. Each match includes a slug and tool names. Run one with call_indexed_tool.

tools.name: get_record
tools.description: Look up one directory item by id, slug, or exact name.

tools.name: recommend_records
tools.description: Pick public MCP servers from the full Index for a need. Each line names the slug and tool to pass to call_indexed_tool. Search here before calling a server.

tools.name: compare_records
tools.description: Compare two to five directory items by id, slug, or exact name. Returns stored details and the fields that differ.

tools.name: list_sections
tools.description: Show the sections in MCP for AgentStatus MCP Index.

tools.name: call_indexed_tool
tools.description: Run a tool on a public MCP server from the full AgentStatus Index. This connection does not list those servers. Call search_records or recommend_records first, then pass that slug and tool. The call is sent to that server and its result is returned here.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "recommend_records" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Pick public MCP servers from the full Index for a need. Each line names the slug and tool to pass to call_indexed_tool. Search here before calling a server.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
